domains.name: AI System & Societal Impact Assessment
domains.description: Assessing impact of an AI system on individuals, groups and society across its lifecycle.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Run one AI System Impact Assessment (per ISO/IEC 42005) per AI system; its output satisfies ISO 42001 6.1.4/8.4, EU AI Act FRIA-adjacent needs, GDPR DPIA overlap, and NIST Map 5.

domains.name: AI System Classification, Scope & Categorization
domains.description: Determining what an AI system is, its intended use, risk tier and applicability of each framework.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Maintain one AI system inventory with fields for EU AI Act risk tier, ISO 42001/27001 scope and NIST categorization - classify once, reuse everywhere.

domains.name: Access Control & Identity Management
domains.description: Identity lifecycle, authentication, authorization, privileged access and segregation of duties.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One IAM/PAM programme (incl. MFA and periodic access review) satisfies ISO 27001 5.15-5.18/8.2-8.5 and the access-control expectations referenced across AI and privacy frameworks.

domains.name: Asset Inventory & Information Classification
domains.description: Knowing what information/AI/data/tooling assets exist and classifying them.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One asset and AI-resource inventory with a classification scheme underpins nearly every other domain - do this early, once, and reference it from all frameworks.

domains.name: Business Continuity, Resilience & Availability
domains.description: Maintaining availability of systems and services under disruption.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One BCP/DR programme with tested RTO/RPO covers ISO 27001 5.29-5.30/8.6/8.13-8.14, DORA Art.11-12, and the availability expectations in EU AI Act Art.15 and GDPR Art.32.

domains.name: Cryptography, Masking & Data Loss Prevention
domains.description: Encryption, key management, data masking, DLP and controlled deletion.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One cryptography and data-protection standard (encryption at rest/in transit, masking rules, deletion schedule) covers ISO 27001 8.10-8.12/8.24, GDPR Art.32, and ISO 42001/27701 equivalents.

domains.name: Data Governance, Quality & Provenance (AI/ML data)
domains.description: Managing training/validation/operational data: sourcing, quality, lineage and preparation.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One data governance procedure with dataset documentation and lineage tracking covers ISO 42001 A.7.x, EU AI Act Art.10, and NIST Map/Measure data-related items.

domains.name: Data Provenance & Lineage
domains.description: Securely deriving and recording provenance metadata - chain of custody, transformations, actors - for data assets including AI training data and model lineage.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Use the Data Governance Register (Tab 19) as the working log, following ISO/IEC 5181's secure-derivation techniques, to produce the provenance evidence that ISO 42001 A.7.5 and EU AI Act Art.10 require.

domains.name: Data Subject / Individual Rights & Transparency
domains.description: Providing information to and honouring the rights of individuals/PII principals/deployers.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One rights-request handling process (access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability) plus one transparency-notice template covers GDPR Chapter III, EU AI Act Art.13/50, ISO 27701 7.3/8.3 and OECD 1.3.

domains.name: Documentation, Records & Configuration Control
domains.description: Controlling documented information, technical documentation and configuration/records over time.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One document-control and configuration-management system (versioning, approval workflow, retention) satisfies the documented-information clauses across every management-system framework in this workbook.

domains.name: Framework-Specific (no direct cross-framework equivalent)
domains.description: Items unique to one framework with no meaningful equivalent elsewhere in this workbook (e.g. EU AI Act prohibited practices/scope, OECD broad policy recommendations, ISO 17021 certification-body-only clauses, standard-identification/status rows).
domains.consolidation_guidance: No consolidation possible - address individually per framework; do not expect another control to cover these.

domains.name: GenAI/LLM Attack Surface (OWASP)
domains.description: The specific attack techniques against LLM/GenAI applications: prompt injection, poisoning, agency abuse, etc.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Treat this as the technical test plan executed inside the 'Secure AI Development, Testing & Robustness' domain above - these risks are what your red-team/adversarial testing should target.

domains.name: Governance, Policy & Leadership
domains.description: Top-management commitment, policy set (security/privacy/AI), scope, context, resources, communication and general management-system plumbing.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Write one integrated policy set and one management-system manual/context statement covering security, privacy and AI; reuse it (with framework-specific annexes) instead of writing separate policies per standard.

domains.name: Human Oversight & Responsible Use of AI
domains.description: Ensuring humans can understand, monitor, intervene in and appropriately use AI systems.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One human-oversight design standard and acceptable-use policy for AI covers EU AI Act Art.14/9.4, ISO 42001 A.9.x, and OECD 1.2/1.3.

domains.name: Human Resources Security & Awareness
domains.description: Screening, contracts, confidentiality, competence, AI literacy and security/privacy awareness training.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One HR-security and training programme (screening, NDAs, role-based awareness incl. AI literacy) satisfies ISO 27001 Annex A.6, ISO 42001 7.2/7.3, EU AI Act Art.4, and ISO 27701/31700/17021 competence items.

domains.name: ISO 27090 / OWASP AI Threat Catalogue (Poisoning, Evasion, Extraction, Injection)
domains.description: The named AI-specific attack types common to both ISO/IEC 27090 and OWASP's LLM Top 10: data/model poisoning, evasion, membership inference, model inversion, model stealing, prompt/output injection.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Build one adversarial-testing programme (red team + automated adversarial test suite) that works through this exact threat list once; it satisfies ISO/IEC 27090 Clause 6, OWASP LLM01-LLM09, and feeds directly into MITRE ATLAS's AI Attack Staging tactic test scope.

domains.name: Improvement & Corrective Action
domains.description: Nonconformity handling, root-cause analysis and continual improvement.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One CAPA (corrective and preventive action) process, applied across security, privacy and AI findings, satisfies every framework's improvement clause.

domains.name: Incident Management & Breach Notification
domains.description: Detecting, responding to and reporting security/privacy/AI incidents.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One incident response plan with regulator/stakeholder notification workflows (timelines tuned per framework) covers ISO 27001 5.24-5.27, GDPR Art.33/34, EU AI Act Art.73, DORA's 4-hour/72-hour/1-month timeline, ISO 42001/27701 incident items, and NIST Manage 4.

domains.name: Internal Audit, Management Review & Certification
domains.description: Internal audits, management reviews, and the certification/surveillance process itself.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One internal-audit programme and one management-review cadence covering all management systems together satisfies ISO 27001/42001/27701 9.2/9.3 in a single combined audit, and is what ISO 17021-1 Clause 9 examines.

domains.name: Legal, Regulatory & Compliance Obligations
domains.description: Tracking applicable laws/regulations/contracts and the penalties for non-compliance.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One legal/regulatory register (mapped to GDPR, EU AI Act, DORA, PDPPL, sector rules) feeds the 'legal requirements' clause present in almost every framework.

domains.name: Logging, Monitoring & Detection
domains.description: Generating, protecting and reviewing logs; continuous monitoring for anomalies.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One centralized logging/SIEM capability with defined retention satisfies ISO 27001 8.15-8.17, ISO 42001 A.6.2.8, EU AI Act Art.12/19/26, NIST Measure 3, and gives you the detection layer ATLAS's tactics assume exists.

domains.name: MITRE ATLAS Tactics (Adversary Attack Lifecycle)
domains.description: The full adversary attack-chain perspective - reconnaissance through impact - specific to AI/ML systems, with real-world case studies behind each technique.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Use ATLAS to scope and sequence red-team exercises and SOC detection use cases across the whole attack lifecycle, rather than testing only the 'AI Attack Staging' and 'Impact' tactics that overlap with OWASP/ISO 27090 - the earlier-lifecycle tactics (recon, initial access, persistence) need their own detection coverage too.

domains.name: Network & Infrastructure Security
domains.description: Network segmentation, cloud security, malware/endpoint protection, capacity and web filtering.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One network/cloud security architecture and endpoint protection baseline covers ISO 27001 Annex A.8 network/infrastructure controls and the infrastructure resource items in ISO 42001 A.4.5.

domains.name: Operational Resilience & ICT Third-Party Risk (DORA)
domains.description: ICT risk management, resilience testing (incl. TLPT), incident classification/reporting timelines, and ICT third-party/concentration risk specific to EU financial entities.
domains.consolidation_guidance: If any AI system or its infrastructure falls under DORA's scope (EU-regulated financial entity, or a provider to one), fold its ICT risk management framework, backup/resilience testing and third-party Register of Information into the same risk, BCP and supplier-management processes already built for ISO 27001/42001 - don't run a parallel DORA-only programme.

domains.name: Physical & Environmental Security
domains.description: Physical access, environmental protection, equipment and media handling.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One physical security standard applied across all facilities/data centres covers all ISO 27001 Annex A.7 items in one pass.

domains.name: Privacy by Design Principles (Proactive, Default, Embedded, Lifecycle)
domains.description: The foundational design philosophy (Cavoukian's 7 principles) and its ISO-certifiable realization in ISO/IEC 31700 for consumer goods/services.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Bake these principles into product-design checklists and design-review gates once; both Tab 14 (philosophy) and Tab 15 (ISO 31700 certifiable requirements) draw on the same underlying practices - treat Tab 15 as the auditable version of Tab 14.

domains.name: Privacy-Specific Controls (collection, minimisation, transfer)
domains.description: Lawful basis, consent, minimisation, special-category handling, cross-border transfer safeguards.
domains.consolidation_guidance: A single privacy programme (lawful-basis register, minimisation-by-design, transfer mechanism library) satisfies GDPR Chapter II/V and the equivalent ISO 27701 Clause 7/8 items.

domains.name: Risk Assessment & Treatment
domains.description: The core risk identification, analysis, evaluation and treatment process (security, privacy and AI risk).
domains.consolidation_guidance: Run one risk assessment methodology and one risk register that tags each risk as security/privacy/AI so a single treatment plan and SoA feed every framework's risk clauses.

domains.name: Risk Quantification (FAIR)
domains.description: Quantifying risk scenarios in frequency and financial-loss-magnitude terms, on top of the qualitative risk register above.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Apply FAIR to your highest-priority qualitative risks (from the Risk Assessment & Treatment domain) to add a quantified, Monte Carlo-based loss-exceedance view for board/executive reporting - don't run it as a separate, disconnected exercise.

domains.name: Roles, Responsibilities & Accountability
domains.description: Defining and assigning who owns security, privacy, AI risk and each management system.
domains.consolidation_guidance: Build one RACI covering ISMS/AIMS/PIMS/DPO/AI-governance roles, including the EU AI Act's Provider/Deployer/Importer/Distributor roles; most frameworks accept the same role assignments with minor scope notes.

domains.name: Secure AI Development, Testing & Robustness
domains.description: Secure SDLC, architecture, coding, change management and adversarial/robustness testing.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One secure-development lifecycle with security gates and adversarial/red-team testing satisfies ISO 27001 8.25-8.34, ISO 42001 A.6.2.x, EU AI Act Art.15, NIST Measure 2, and directly mitigates most OWASP LLM Top 10 and ISO/IEC 27090 threats.

domains.name: Third-Party, Supplier & AI Supply Chain
domains.description: Supplier/vendor risk management, contracts, ICT and AI supply-chain assurance.
domains.consolidation_guidance: One supplier risk-management programme (due diligence, security clauses, SBOM/MLBOM, ongoing monitoring) covers ISO 27001 5.19-5.22, ISO 42001 A.10.x, EU AI Act value-chain provisions, GDPR Art.28, DORA Art.28-30, and NIST Govern 6/Map 4/Manage 3.
